exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to cease, to quit
to hand over, to deliver, to give
to cross, to get over, to get across
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: переста́ть — to stop, to cease, to quit; переда́ть — to hand over, to deliver, to give; перейти́ — to cross, to get over, to get across; переби́ть — to interrupt, to break.
**перевел** — перевести́ (perfective): to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret; to remit (money). Wiktionary: пере- + вести́.
